unit_attributes.statement: A material discrepancy is defined as any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When there are material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity, except as provided for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C).
unit_attributes.choice_text: Submission of one or more of: (1) Court orders or decrees: (a) Name change orders, or (b) Divorce decrees; (2) Certificates of naturalization; (3) Marriage certificates; (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or (5) Documentation of customary usage.
unit_attributes.logic_text: must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section (see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C))
unit_attributes.statement: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more acceptable documents (including name change orders, divorce decrees, certificates of naturalization, marriage certificates, documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law, or documentation of customary usage), except as provided for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C).

unit_attributes.scope_text: For evidence of material name changes.

unit_attributes.statement: The applicant must not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name.

unit_attributes.statement: Because the applicant's name is an integral part of identity, under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant.

unit_attributes.scope_text: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change.
unit_attributes.logic_text: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.
unit_attributes.statement: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When an applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, and there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel.
unit_attributes.logic_text: If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name
unit_attributes.statement: If an applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 without updating ID to reflect the change, and there is insufficient time to request acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name.

unit_attributes.logic_text: The applicant generally will need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID.
unit_attributes.statement: The applicant generally will need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When returning name change documentation to the applicant with an information request letter (IRL) (such as after suspending an application to request acceptable ID in the new name).
unit_attributes.logic_text: You must fully notate the name change documentation prior to returning the documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned," to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL)
unit_attributes.statement: You must fully notate the name change documentation prior to returning the documentation to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL), including noting that the documentation was "seen and returned."

unit_attributes.scope_text: For applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11.
unit_attributes.logic_text: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 do not need to submit ID in the new name.
unit_attributes.statement: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 are not required to submit ID in the new name.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11, if the ID has not yet been changed.
unit_attributes.logic_text: However, if the ID has not yet been changed, they must submit their name change documentation.
unit_attributes.statement: For applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11, if the ID has not yet been changed, they must submit their name change documentation.
